fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Shown once when the studio connects the partner in Kenko, or when it creates a new key

fields.label: Center ID
fields.placeholder: Optional — the key already names the center
fields.description: Optional center UUID. If set, it must match the center the key is bound to, or Kenko answers 403

fields.label: Connection ID
fields.placeholder: Optional — routes Kenko webhooks to this account
fields.description: Studio connection UUID Kenko hands over with the key (kenko_list_centers shows it too). Incoming webhooks carry it, so setting it here lets deliveries land on this account
